title: Sloped roof assembly from component families
use_when: framing and finishing a sloped (shed, mono-pitch) roof as an assembly of lumber, sheet and board families
placing sheet goods, insulation or trim on a sloped plane
covering rafter tails and fly rafters with fascia and barge boards
not_for: prefabricated trusses modelled as single families

environment.tool: RevitBridge 0.4.0 (local Revit API bridge, MCP) with run_csharp

changelog.change: Added v06: BOM check found a deck stagger error and inherited type data; shop drawing W104 and cost estimate
Owner rule: insulation only inside the exterior wall lines, never over overhangs; verified on the model
Owner correction: members that carry the deck (outlookers, blocking under the deck) are rotated to the slope, top face parallel to the rafters; replaces 'sit level at the uphill edge'
Wedge under the roof (pony wall, raked infill) gets the full exterior wall build-up inside the roof assembly; sloped-edge pieces as DirectShapes
